description: CREATE FUNCTION and CREATE PROCEDURE accept a RETURNS <type> NOT NULL return clause, where the NOT NULL is INFORMATIONAL - it parses and the routine runs, and the plain RETURNS without it still works. Previously the NOT NULL suffix failed to parse at all. Converted 1:1 from scripting/ProcedureReturnsNotNullTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE p() RETURNS VARCHAR NOT NULL LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 'hi'; END; $$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION f() RETURNS NUMBER NOT NULL AS $$ 42 $$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION g() RETURNS NUMBER AS $$ 7 $$
